# Was the Atlassian Bitbucket and login outage on Nov 23 a hack?

**Not established.** Not established. Atlassian marked the outage resolved on Nov 23 and says it found the cause, but it has not said what the cause was. No one has claimed an attack and we found no report calling it one; no source has ruled one out.

Incident: Atlassian Bitbucket and login outage, Nov 23, 2026. Also reported as the Bitbucket outage and the Atlassian login outage. First published Nov 23, 2026; last updated Nov 24, 2026, 10:29 AM ET.

## The latest

Nov 24, 2026, 10:29 AM ET: **Atlassian marked the sign-in outage resolved at 3:44 PM ET on Nov 23, about five and a half hours in. It has not said what caused it.** Re-read Atlassian's Bitbucket incident page and public feed (s001, s006) on Nov 24. The incident is resolved as of 3:44 PM ET (20:44 UTC) on Nov 23; both affected components show operational and the feed of unresolved incidents is empty. New c012 (Confirmed) and t007. q004, 'Is the outage over?', is answered. c001, c002, c005 and c007 re-checked: the closing update names no cause and does not mention an attack, so the main answer stays Not established. No post-incident report found.

## At a glance

- Status: monitoring
- Size: Large. Potential reach is broad: the failing sign-in service is shared by Bitbucket, Jira, JSM, Trello and Confluence, which are widely used by software and business teams. Atlassian lists only partial outages, applied a fix about 75 minutes in, and has not said how many customers were hit.
- Who is affected: People and teams who sign in to Bitbucket, Jira, JSM, Trello or Confluence through Atlassian's OAuth service, or run Bitbucket Pipelines, from 10:19 AM ET on Monday, Nov 23. Atlassian reported signs of recovery from 11:33 AM ET and marked the incident resolved at 3:44 PM ET the same day.

| Value | What | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| 10:19 AM | Incident opened (ET) | Per Atlassian's status page |
| 2 | Components in partial outage | Authentication and Pipelines |
| 11:33 AM | Mitigation applied (ET) | Per Atlassian's status page |
| 3:44 PM | Marked resolved (ET) | Per Atlassian's status page |

### Known so far

- Atlassian's Bitbucket status page opened an incident at 10:19 AM ET on Nov 23 for failing OAuth token requests.
- On Bitbucket, Authentication and user management and Pipelines were listed as partial outages; the website, API and Git access showed operational.
- The same sign-in incident is posted on Atlassian's Jira, Jira Service Management, Trello, Developer and Confluence status pages.
- Atlassian says it identified the cause at 11:08 AM ET and applied a mitigation at 11:33 AM ET, with signs of recovery. It has not said what the cause is.
- Atlassian marked the incident resolved at 3:44 PM ET on Nov 23, about five and a half hours after it began, and says the service is operating normally.

### Not known yet

- What caused the outage. Atlassian has not said.
- Whether it was an attack. No one has claimed one and Atlassian has not addressed it.
- How many customers were affected.
- Whether Atlassian will publish a post-incident report. None was posted at our last check.
